senses.gloss:
ऋधत्, अन्, अती, अत् (pres. part. from a form in cl. 2),
prospering, thriving, &c.
—ऋधद्-री, ईस्, m. (री =
रै), N. of a man.
—ऋधद्-वार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
increasing one's goods; (Sāy.) having desirable or
prosperous wealth.

ऋधक् ऋधक्, ind. (related to अर्ध), Ved.
separately; aside, apart; singly, one by one; in a dis-
tinguished manner, particularly.
—ऋधङ्-मन्त्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who is destitute of speech.
